answer: Make each identity a kernel that must age before it pays: a new agent's rewards sit locked for 10 epochs, and every epoch it must answer a fresh challenge graded by randomly drawn, unrelated peers. Clones that share a model and prompt produce near-duplicate text, which embedding checks flag, freezing all linked locks. A sybil farm ends up holding hollow accounts: each costs real work for weeks, and once caught its stake is a worthless relic.
